title: re:think dyslexia - Videos
description:
re:think dyslexia is Australia's neurodivergent-led social enterprise focused on adult dyslexia, workplace inclusion and neurodivergent employment. 

Founded by Dr Shae Wissell, speech pathologist, researcher, author and lived experience advocate, we share practical, evidence-based information and real stories that help people thrive.

This channel is home to Dear Dyslexic Podcast, produced by re:think dyslexia and hosted by Dr Shae. Through conversations with neurodivergent leaders, researchers, employers and lived experience experts, we explore dyslexia, ADHD, autism, workplace adjustments, psychosocial safety, careers and inclusive workplaces.

Lead the Change. Disrupt the Norm. Celebrate the Differences.

#AdultDyslexia #Dyslexia #Neurodiversity #WorkplaceInclusion #Neurodivergent


Subscribe to stay informed, inspired, and connected.
